name.value: Family of Riders Bike Shop (FOR Bikes)

description.value: Family of Riders Bike Co is a full-service bicycle shop on Bowen Road in Nanaimo stocking a broad range of bikes—mountain, gravel, electric, commuter, and children's—from brands including Devinci, Norco, and Orbea. Professionally trained technicians assess every bike alongside the customer before work begins, and the shop offers both comprehensive tune-up packages and a-la-carte repairs. The shop also organizes the local 'Tour de Gnarnaimo Challenge,' inviting riders to explore every zone of Nanaimo by self-propelled means.

The service page explicitly describes walk-in assessment before repairs begin ('all bike are assessed with you before going in the stand'), and the store locator/location pages provided a phone number (250-585-7401) absent from OSM. A minor name discrepancy exists between OSM ('Family of Riders Bike Shop (FOR Bikes)') and the website ('Family of Riders Bike Co'), and one location subpage shows a different postal code (V9T5P2) versus the consistently used V9S 1H8.
